lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The morning after Lark Hill. The wagons burned|in the night. The people will have to walk.
lines.text: The morning after Lark Hill. The wagons burned in the night. The people will have to walk.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: One road, the Fire border at the end of it,|and everyone we kept alive. We walk them there.
lines.text: One road, the Fire border at the end of it, and everyone we kept alive. We walk them there.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: The western woods are old and full of ears.|Some of those ears are Malrik's.
lines.text: The western woods are old and full of ears. Some of those ears are Malrik's.

lines.speaker: messenger
lines.subtitle: The first ones are ready, my lady.|Ring the lantern and they'll go.
lines.text: The first ones are... they're ready, my lady. Ring the lantern and... they'll go.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: I'll run ahead and smell the road. Call me|when your tree grows tall enough to shout.
lines.text: I'll run ahead and smell the road. Call me when your tree grows tall enough to shout.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Don't fight them all on|your own. Leave me a few.
lines.text: Don't fight them all on your own. Leave me a few.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Torvald froze the brook. The old folk|will slip, and his archers know it.
lines.text: Torvald froze the brook. The old folk will slip, and his archers know it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Stay on the road. If anything moves in the|trees, stop, and let the thorns go first.
lines.text: Stay on the road. If anything moves in the trees, stop, and let the thorns go first.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Knives in the oak! Down, everyone down!|Thornlings, into the ferns!
lines.text: Knives in the oak! Down, everyone down! Thornlings, into the ferns!

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: Little lambs on a little road.|The Bishop sends his regards.
lines.text: Little lambs on a little road. The Bishop sends his regards.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: You burned their wagons.|You don't get their children.
lines.text: You burned their wagons. You don't get their children.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Maelis! The Heartwood stands|tall enough. Come home.
lines.text: Maelis! The Heartwood stands tall enough. Come home.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: I went to see the brook. It is cold,|it is guarded, and it is very rude.
lines.text: I went to see the brook. It is cold, it is guarded, and it is very rude.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: Nature folk at the gate! Open up, lads.|Blankets, bread, and no questions.
lines.text: Nature folk at the gate! Open up, lads. Blankets, bread, and no questions.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: Another night, then.|There is always another night.
lines.text: Another night, then. There is always another night.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: They're through. Ring it again, Wren.
lines.text: They're through. Ring it again, Wren.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: No... Keep moving.|We grieve at the border. Not here.
lines.text: No... Keep moving. We grieve at the border. Not here.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Listen. The brook's talking again.|It says thank you, roughly.
lines.text: Listen. The brook's talking again. It says thank you, roughly.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Their nest is ash. Malrik will|need new hunters, and new excuses.
lines.text: Their nest is ash. Malrik will need new hunters, and new excuses.

lines.speaker: hush
lines.subtitle: The knife never misses, Ysolde.|It only waits for the right neck.
lines.text: The knife never misses, Ysolde. It only waits for the right neck.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Then it can wait forever.|Maelis, stay with the people.
lines.text: Then it can wait forever. Maelis, stay with the people.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Make way for the old herd!
lines.text: Make way for the old herd!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The last of them leave Larkrest.|Behind them, the green road goes quiet.
lines.text: The last of them leave Larkrest. Behind them, the green road goes quiet.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Everything they have left is coming.|Good. It means we're nearly there.
lines.text: Everything they have left is coming. Good. It means we're nearly there.

lines.speaker: ashby
lines.subtitle: That's the lot, my lady. The border's yours|whenever you want it. The queen said so.
lines.text: That's the lot, my lady. The border's yours whenever you want it. The queen said so.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Thank her for me. And tell her I'm not staying.
lines.text: Thank her for me. And tell her I'm not staying.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: The Sighing Wood, then?|Burnt, frozen, and still ours.
lines.text: The Sighing Wood, then? Burnt, frozen, and still ours.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: A seed doesn't wait for the war|to end, Maelis. Neither do I.
lines.text: A seed doesn't wait for the war to end, Maelis. Neither do I.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Keep... walking...
lines.text: Keep... walking...

lines.speaker: messenger
lines.subtitle: We lost too many on the road.|My lady, we can't go on.
lines.text: We... we lost too many on the road. My lady, we can't... we can't go on.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: Larkrest is burning. There's|nothing left to walk away from.
lines.text: Larkrest is burning. There's nothing left to walk away from.
